description: This Java class 'FormulasPane' is part of a UI module for displaying and updating mathematical formulas related to engine control algorithms, including rendering LaTeX formulas, handling user interactions, and fetching sensor data.

classes.name: FormulasPane
classes.description: A Swing UI component that displays engine control formulas, updates them periodically, and allows user interactions such as saving images and pausing updates.

methods.name: FormulasPane
methods.description: Constructor initializing UI components, setting up buttons, labels, and a timer for periodic formula updates.

methods.name: updateFormula
methods.description: Fetches sensor data and configuration, determines engine load mode, constructs LaTeX formulas, and updates the display.

methods.name: getAccelerationVariables
methods.description: Generates LaTeX strings for acceleration-related variables based on sensor data and configuration.

methods.name: getSpeedDensity
methods.description: Constructs LaTeX formulas for speed density engine mode calculations.

methods.name: getInjecctorLag
methods.description: Returns LaTeX string for injector lag based on battery voltage.

methods.name: oneDecimal
methods.description: Formats a sensor value as a string with one decimal place.

methods.name: twoDecimals
methods.description: Formats a sensor value as a string with two decimal places.

methods.name: getContent
methods.description: Returns the main JPanel content of the FormulasPane.
